proposition: Automatic acceleration triggered by a bankruptcy filing changes the maturity date from the original stated date to the petition date, precluding make-whole premium claims.

Adopting the reasoning of In re Solutia, the Second Circuit concluded that prepayment can occur only before maturity and that automatic acceleration upon bankruptcy establishes the petition date as the new maturity date.
